deficiencies.description: The lecturer refers to a specific specimen being shown ('this meningioma') that exerted pressure on the brain and caused death in that case. The rewrite generalizes this into a universal statement ('A meningioma occurs within the skull... so it puts an enormous amount of pressure on the brain and the surrounding structures').
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So this meningioma obviously is occurring within the skull. The skull is a confined space. This would put an enormous amount of pressure on the brain and the surrounding structures and would cause and has caused Has caused death in this case.
